title: Orchid Health Wade Creek Clinic Earns Oregon’s Highest Primary Care Distinction
summary: Orchid Health is the leading rural health provider in Oregon. Named as one of the best places to work in 2021, they specialize in whole-person care, patient relationships, and innovation in rural care. They were named the 2020 Rural Health Hero of the year due in part to their efforts in the communities they serve.
body_markdown:
‍ **Orchid Health Wade Creek Clinic Earns Oregon’s Highest Primary Care Distinction** ‍


**ESTACADA, OR** — Orchid Health’s Wade Creek Clinic has officially been verified as a Tier 5 Patient-Centered Primary Care Home (PCPCH)—the highest tier achievable under the Oregon Health Authority’s recognition program. In addition to reaching Tier 5 status, Wade Creek Clinic was awarded the state’s prestigious new Health Equity designation, honoring rural health centers that demonstrate exceptional leadership in delivering inclusive, whole-person medical and behavioral healthcare.


The Oregon PCPCH program evaluates primary care practices across the state based on accessibility, patient-centeredness, care coordination, and overall clinical quality. Tier 5 represents the pinnacle of primary care excellence, reflecting a practice that continuously meets rigorous standards to optimize patient outcomes in the community.


The Health Equity designation recognizes clinics that actively go above and beyond standard care to eliminate health disparities. Wade Creek Clinic earned this distinction for its commitment to identifying and addressing the unique social, cultural, and linguistic needs of patients throughout Estacada and the surrounding rural region.


"This dual recognition is a testament to our team’s deep dedication to our patients and the Estacada community," said Orion Falvey, Co-Founder and Executive Director of Orchid Health. "We are dedicated to ensuring that every individual, regardless of where they live, their background or circumstances, has access to exceptional, local healthcare."


By offering unrushed appointments, integrated physical and behavioral health services, a sliding-fee scale program, and partnerships like no out-of-pocket cost for local students, the Wade Creek Clinic continues to redefine accessible healthcare for rural Oregonians. These new state honors reinforce the clinic’s position as a trusted, community-centered health home.


To learn more about Orchid Health Wade Creek Clinic or to schedule an appointment, please visit www.orchidhealth.org/estacada.html or call (503) 630-8550.


**About Orchid Health & Wade Creek Clinic**


Orchid Health was founded on the belief that rural communities deserve local, high-quality, and accessible healthcare. Located in Estacada, Oregon, Orchid Health’s Wade Creek Clinic provides primary care, behavioral health, preventive care, and community outreach services designed to foster long-term health, equity, and well-being.
